notes: Published immutable v0.1.27 via PR #35. User approved Android scroll optimization on 2026-09-08; implemented bounded native row windows, off-Main reusable projection, local pixel navigation/source rebinding, hardware row display lists, and multi-page physical-edge overlap. Full just check, Android lint/JVM/build, six pixel tests, native integration, keyboard/Chinese/Copy/Activity retention and isolated Herdr/child-pointer acceptance pass. Adjacent old/new emulator comparison: gesture draw p50 15.01 -> 1.79 ms, p95 20.11 -> 5.30 ms; manual drag/reversal frame timing is not uniformly improved, physical-phone acceptance remains open. Restored ordinary Dev 0.1.27 on the owned emulator, then updated the physical phone (1680fce0) on explicit user request; installed APK hash matches the tested 8c61cdf0 build. Phone visual/scrolling acceptance awaits user trial. Pending Phase 3.4 commit workflow; no new release or real daemon activation. Keep prior keyboard-close history refill and broader desktop/phone visual acceptance open. See research/android-scroll-optimization.md and research/android-scroll-handoff.md. User now accepts physical-phone scrolling (测试了一下非常棒) and explicitly authorizes all commits and v0.1.28 publication. Earlier phone-trial/commit-pending statements are superseded. Keep the separate keyboard-close and desktop visual gaps open.
